PlatformAuth._comment: SecretKey MUST equal the payroll API's APP_SECRET_KEY - the same token is validated by both services.
PlatformAuth._policies_comment: Maps this service's policies onto permission codes the platform already issues, so no change to the Python SYSTEM_PERMISSIONS catalog is needed. Dedicated rti:* codes are listed alongside for a later zero-downtime cutover.

Hmrc._gating_comment: SOW gating rule 3 - live submissions require AllowLiveSubmission=true AND ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production.
